subject.title: fix(plugins): preserve already-loaded plugins across scoped harness activation

question: Should scoped harness activation preserve the global registry through a non-reloading merge/pin mechanism, or is re-registering every active plugin an accepted runtime contract?
rationale: The choice defines global plugin lifecycle semantics and determines whether registration side effects and hot-path latency are acceptable during harness activation.

options.title: Preserve without reloading
options.body: Merge or pin existing registry surfaces while loading only missing harness plugins, retaining current capabilities without invoking unrelated register functions again.

options.title: Accept full active-plugin reload
options.body: Keep this implementation only if maintainers explicitly accept repeated registration work and add proof covering side-effectful external plugins.

options.title: Move preservation into the loader
options.body: Pause this PR and implement one canonical registry-activation preservation mechanism that also covers related replacement paths.

recommendation.title: Preserve without reloading
recommendation.body: Merge or pin existing registry surfaces while loading only missing harness plugins, retaining current capabilities without invoking unrelated register functions again.

likelyOwner.reason: The loader-cache work directly established the relevant registration and side-effect constraints.
